articles.summary: Innovation Showcase: Menten AI, Inc. Menten AI's CEO, Hans Melo, and VP of Business Development, Andrea McNeal, attended and presented at BioEurope 2025 this November 3–5. The event brings together global leaders in biotechnology and pharma to explore collaborations and innovation in drug discovery. We look forward to sharing Menten AI’s latest advances in AI-driven protein design and connecting with partners shaping the future of biotech.
articles.title: Menten AI presents at BioEurope 2025
